item.title: Lincolnshire Waste Partnership supporting Love Food Hate Waste’s Food Waste Action Week
item.description: Food Waste Action Week is WRAP’s flagship annual campaign from the Love Food Hate Waste initiative, uniting governments, communities, charities and businesses to help tackle food waste.
